controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-13T00:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-13T23:59:59.000Z"
        AND (source.ip == "172.18.0.16" OR client.ip == "172.18.0.16" OR host.ip == "172.18.0.16"
             OR source.ip == "172.18.0.9" OR client.ip == "172.18.0.9" OR host.ip == "172.18.0.9"
             OR source.ip == "172.18.0.24" OR client.ip == "172.18.0.24" OR host.ip == "172.18.0.24")
| STATS events = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name, source.ip, client.ip, host.ip, data_stream.dataset
| SORT events DESC
